headline: Binance Freezes $3 Billion and Halts Withdrawals Following Major Hack
summary: Binance suspended withdrawals and froze roughly $3 billion with help from stablecoin issuers following a major theft. The exchange pledged to reimburse users with corporate funds as the attacker holds approximately $2.4 billion.
why: Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume; security incidents at the platform impact liquidity across digital asset markets.

impacts.name: Binance
impacts.why: Binance suspended withdrawals and suffered a multi-billion dollar exploit, requiring it to pledge corporate funds for user restitution.
